subject: Add unit test coverage for vsetMemUsage(), vsetClear() and vsetIsValid() (#4341)
reason: The change only adds C++ unit tests (test_vset.cpp) and a build-system tweak restricting -fno-var-tracking-assignments to GCC for the unit-test target. No server, replication, persistence, command, or tool code changes: there is no runtime behaviour a scenario could exercise or compare.
